name: JavaScript
description: The language of the web. JavaScript powers browsers, servers (Node.js), desktop apps (Electron), and increasingly the edge. These are the definitive free resources — vetted, current, and complete.

items.title: Eloquent JavaScript (4th Edition)
items.description: A modern introduction covering core language features, the browser environment, and Node.js. Widely considered the best free JS book.

items.title: You Don't Know JS Yet
items.description: An in-depth series exploring the core mechanisms of JavaScript — closures, prototypes, async, and more.

items.title: The Modern JavaScript Tutorial
items.description: A massive, detailed guide covering everything from fundamentals to advanced async programming, DOM manipulation, and browser APIs.

items.title: Exploring JS: JavaScript for Programmers
items.description: A comprehensive reference by Dr. Axel Rauschmayer covering ES6+ features, modules, async patterns, and TypeScript.

items.title: MDN Web Docs — JavaScript Guide
items.description: The definitive manual for the JavaScript language. Covers grammar, control flow, functions, objects, classes, promises, and iterators.

items.title: MDN — JavaScript Reference
items.description: Complete reference for all built-in objects, statements, operators, and expressions.

items.title: TC39 ECMAScript Proposals
items.description: Official repository tracking all ECMAScript proposals through the standardization pipeline.

items.title: The Odin Project — Full Stack JavaScript
items.description: A world-class open-source curriculum from absolute beginner to building full-stack applications.

items.title: freeCodeCamp — JavaScript Algorithms & Data Structures
items.description: Hands-on interactive coding challenges teaching syntax, functional programming, and algorithmic problem-solving.

items.title: JavaScript Programming — Full Course (freeCodeCamp)
items.description: A comprehensive multi-hour video masterclass covering JavaScript from scratch to professional proficiency.

items.title: Full-Stack Web Development Playlist
items.description: freeCodeCamp curated playlist covering HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Node.js, React, and databases.

items.title: Exercism — JavaScript Track
items.description: Over 150 structured coding exercises with optional community mentoring.

items.title: Codewars
items.description: Gamified coding platform with community-authored kata across hundreds of difficulty levels.

items.title: Edabit
items.description: Bite-sized interactive challenges from very easy to expert. Builds fast muscle memory.

items.title: Devhints — ES2015+ Cheatsheet
items.description: A concise one-page reference covering modern ES6+ syntax: destructuring, arrow functions, promises, and modules.

items.title: JS: The Right Way
items.description: A curated guide to the best practices, tools, and resources for modern JavaScript development.

items.title: JavaScript Weekly
items.description: A free weekly email roundup of the latest JavaScript articles, tutorials, tools, and releases.

items.title: Proposals.es
items.description: A community browser for tracking ECMAScript proposals through their standardization stages.

items.title: Reddit r/javascript
items.description: The largest JavaScript community on Reddit — news, discussions, show & tell, and career advice.

items.title: Stack Overflow — JavaScript Tag
items.description: The definitive Q&A forum for troubleshooting errors and resolving language bugs.

items.title: JSConf
items.description: The umbrella organization for community-driven JavaScript conferences worldwide.

lessons.title: Values, Types, and Variables
lessons.description: Core JavaScript values — primitives, objects, type system, and variable declarations (var, let, const). Set up your dev environment and write your first program.

lessons.title: Control Flow, Operators, and Expressions
lessons.description: Conditionals, loops, operators, and expression evaluation — the building blocks of program logic.

lessons.title: Functions: Declarations, Scope, and Arrow Functions
lessons.description: Function declarations, expressions, arrow functions, parameters, and arguments — the core of JS modularity.

lessons.title: Objects, Arrays, and Collections
lessons.description: JavaScript objects, arrays, Maps, Sets — creating, accessing, iterating, and manipulating data structures.

lessons.title: The DOM and Browser APIs
lessons.description: Document Object Model, DOM manipulation, event handling, and essential browser APIs.

lessons.title: Debugging, Errors, and Developer Tools
lessons.description: Browser DevTools, error types, try/catch/finally, stack traces, and debugging strategies.

lessons.title: Beginner Project: Interactive Web Application
lessons.description: Build a complete interactive web application using all beginner concepts — DOM manipulation, events, arrays, and localStorage.

lessons.title: Deep Scope, Hoisting, and Closures
lessons.description: Lexical scope, hoisting mechanics, closure patterns, IIFEs, and the module pattern.

lessons.title: The `this` Keyword, Prototypes, and Classes
lessons.description: The `this` binding rules, prototype chain inheritance, and the ES6 class syntax — understanding JavaScript's unique object model.

lessons.title: Asynchronous JavaScript: Promises and Async/Await
lessons.description: Promises, async/await, error handling in async code, and the evolution of asynchronous patterns in JavaScript.

lessons.title: The Event Loop, Microtasks, and Concurrency
lessons.description: How the JavaScript event loop works: call stack, task queues, microtasks, requestAnimationFrame, and concurrent execution models.

lessons.title: Higher-Order Functions, Iterators, and Generators
lessons.description: Functional programming patterns, custom iterables, generator functions, and async generators.

lessons.title: ES6+ Modules and Modern Syntax
lessons.description: ES modules, modern syntax features (optional chaining, nullish coalescing, logical assignment), and the evolution of JavaScript.

lessons.title: Advanced Project: Real-Time Data Dashboard
lessons.description: Build a real-time data dashboard using async/await, fetch, event-driven architecture, and data visualization.

lessons.title: Type Coercion, Equality, and Grammar
lessons.description: The ECMAScript specification algorithms for type coercion, abstract equality, and the syntactic grammar of JavaScript.

lessons.title: Memory Management, GC, and Performance
lessons.description: JavaScript memory management, garbage collection algorithms, memory leak patterns, and performance optimization techniques.

lessons.title: Metaprogramming: Proxy, Reflect, and Symbols
lessons.description: Metaprogramming with Proxy, Reflect API, well-known Symbols, and property descriptors — intercepting and customizing language-level operations.

lessons.title: Error Handling and Defensive Programming
lessons.description: Robust error handling strategies, custom error types, defensive programming, and fault-tolerant design patterns.

lessons.title: Browser APIs, Web Workers, and Performance
lessons.description: Service Workers, IndexedDB, WebSockets, Canvas, WebRTC, and advanced browser performance optimization.

lessons.title: Module Systems, Bundlers, and Pipelines
lessons.description: Deep dive into module resolution algorithms, bundler internals, tree-shaking, code splitting, and modern build tooling.

lessons.title: ECMAScript Spec, TC39, and Future Proposals
lessons.description: Navigating the ECMAScript specification, the TC39 standardization process, reading spec algorithms, and exploring future proposals.
